revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine. There are some things to fix before finalization.
Submit - Integration of BL corrections; S. Russo's, Communicazioni 14; new corrections by both Ben Henry and me.

Commit - Re-submission. I've integrated BL corrections in l. 2, 3 and 5, and readings proposed in S.Russo, Communicazioni 14 for ll. 8 and 9 (she is more assertive in comparison to some of the orig. editor's notes). Additional corrections: in l. 1 Πτολεμα[ῖ]ος => Πτολεμ̣ᾶς (the name is feminine); l. 8 .1[.1].1γ̣.1α τρία=>[ἀ]ν̣γῖα (I've mentioned S.Russo's transcription but she didn't put an under-dot in nu); l. 12 Τρύφωνα ἢ => Τρυφωνᾶτι, and credit goes to Ben Henry for κυρ̣ί̣αν => συρίαν; l. 13 (Ben Henry) ὑποτέθειμαι => ὑποτέθιμαι; l. 16 (Ben Henry) Τρύφωνος => Τρυφωνᾶ̣τ̣ο̣ς̣ (the under-dots are mine, if I may); l. 17 a complicated one: the sender's name appears to be first written as Πτολεμας, and subsequently the sigma was corrected into a lambda, εμ added and then erased. I've credited everything to Ben Henry (if he permits so), whose reading (per email) was Πτολεμ{α}[[λεμ]]ᾶδο̣ς̣ ἀ̣δ̣ελφῆ̣ς̣ (without ref. to a final sigma).
